text:
emily: heads up — noticed a few KB images 503'ing from eu-west CDN when loading runbooks. Happened around 09:12 UTC. Anyone else seeing this?

luca: yep, saw it on staging earlier. Appears to be the signed-url edge TTL expiring earlier than we thought :thinking_face:

marta: do we have a link to an example? I can pick up ownership for the runbook pages if it's the same pattern

emily: example: https://kb.redwood.ai/runbooks/kv-cache#image-1 (served via shortlink). curl shows 503 intermittently:
```
curl -I "https://short.kb.redwood.ai/s/abc123"
HTTP/2 503
server: cdn-edge
```

ryan: tagging @oncall for visibility. @oncall-sre can you confirm if edge signing rotated last night?

docs-bot: link-scan found 5 shortlinks using short.kb.redwood.ai that expire < 24h. See scan report: https://internal/reports/shortlink-scan

marta: I'll take the three affected runbook pages. Assigning to @marta in docs tracker.

luca: quick note — if this is TTL signing we should switch those shortlinks to permanent-hosting (cdn.kb.redwood.ai) and update stakeholders. I'll open a tiny PR for one sample slug.

emily: thanks! if anyone from docs wants the handoff, @marta is the owner for now. Follow-ups in PR please :thumbsup:
